ast_open_failed: The registry of cables and devices cannot be opened: {error}
ast_scan_notfound: No cable or device with the code {code}.
ast_confirm_delete: Delete {code} - {name}? Its code will not be used again.
ast_confirm_delete_used: {n} measurement(s) already name it: they keep the code but lose the card. Retiring it keeps everything.
ast_f_extra: Other details (one per line: name = value)
ast_extra_invalid: Line {n} of the other details is not 'name = value'.
lbl_skip: Places already used on the sheet
ast_t_rate: Fastest change for the worse accepted, per year
ast_t_warn: Warn if the limit is reached within (days)
ast_t_lower_worse: A lower value is worse (for a return loss)
ast_t_none: No finished measurement of {code} has a figure to follow.
lbl_tpl_lines: Lines, one per row. Write the data of the card between braces, for example {id}, {name}, Rev {version}. A line with nothing to show is not printed.
ldg_size: Label size (the same for every kind)
ldg_saved: Saved: the size and the kinds you changed.
ldg_hint: Manual: click an element in the preview and drag it, or use the numbers. Positions are in mm from the top left corner.
ldg_confirm_reset: Forget your changes to "{kind}" and go back to the ready-made design?
ldg_layout_cable: Flag for a cable (from its diameter)
ldg_cable_side: End that goes round the cable
ldg_cable_info: Round the cable: {wrap} mm (blank). Each face of the flag: {face} mm. The two dashed lines: where the wrap ends and the fold. Fold with the adhesive sides together. Shortest label for this cable with faces of 12 mm: {minimum} mm.
ldg_qr_auto: Leave the QR code out when it does not fit
ldg_qr_auto_help: A QR code that would print too small to be read is left out and the text gets the room. Untick it to print it anyway.
ldg_adv_qr_left_out: The QR code does not fit and is left out (the space for the design is {face} mm wide). To have it the design needs at least {min_width} x {min_height} mm with the code beside the text, or {min_width_above} x {min_height_above} mm with the code above it; the code stays on the card, only the text is printed.
ldg_adv_lines_dropped: Not enough room for: {names}. They are left out, from the last one; a bigger label or a smaller list gives them room.
ldg_adv_only_code: Only the code fits on this label.
ldg_adv_text_small: The smallest text is {size} mm high (about {pt} pt): hard to read. Use a bigger label or fewer lines.
ldg_adv_try_rotate: The label is taller than wide: try writing it turned by 90° so the text runs along its length.
lbl_dpi_help: The resolution of your printer: 203 dpi for most thermal printers, 300 dpi for a Brother QL, 600 for fine work. The PNG keeps its real size in millimetres.
lbl_save_each: Save every label as a file...
lbl_save_each_help: One file per label, named with its code, in a folder: for programs that take one image per label (Inkscape, brother_ql, ptouch-print).
ldg_stock_help: Sizes of labels people buy, with the resolution of the printers that use them. Width is the side across the tape, height the side along it. Any size can be typed.
lbl_turn: Turn the output for the printer
lbl_turn_help: For a strip drawn along its length (a cable flag) on a label that the printer feeds the other way: the preview, the PDF, the images and the SVG are turned, so a design of 80 x 50 mm comes out as 50 x 80 mm.
ast_delete_help: Delete the selected measurements from the history: the run file and its waveform files are deleted for good.
ast_delete_confirm:
Delete {n} measurement(s) from the history? The run file and the waveform files are deleted for good:
{files}
